newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine C Bank lowers term reverse repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine C Bank lowers term reverse repo rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it had lowered its term reverse repo rates following the two-percentage point cut in overnight rates.
The five-day and one-month reverse repo rates were cut to 10.875 percent from 11.0 percent.
The two-month reverse repo rate was at 11.0 percent from 11.125 percent, while the six-month reverse repo rate was 11.5 percent from 11.625 percent.
It also offered a three-month reverse repo at 11.1875 percent, a bank official said.
Earlier, the Central Bank cut its overnight lending and borrowing rates by two percentage points each.
Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said the cut was effected after peso-dollar rate had stabilised.
